records.title: Audio MultiChallenge: A Multi-Turn Evaluation of Spoken Dialogue Systems on Natural Human Interaction

project_use_contract.reason: Borrow fixed-context final-turn evaluation, atomic rubrics, semantic-versus-audio-cue memory and voice-edit strata; do not inherit paper scores.

paper_reported_experiment.setting: 452 natural multi-turn conversations, 47 speakers, 1,712 instance rubrics; identical seeded history and final-turn response evaluation.
supported_facts: The protocol isolates the final response from error propagation in earlier generated turns.
Audio-cue memory, voice editing and long audio context expose distinct failures.

records.strongest_boundary_or_falsifier: The fixed-context design measures final-turn competence, not end-to-end recovery from the model's own earlier mistakes; the LLM judge is calibrated but remains a proxy.

records.title: Mem-Gallery: Benchmarking Multimodal Long-Term Conversational Memory for MLLM Agents

project_use_contract.reason: Borrow extraction/adaptation, reasoning, knowledge-update/conflict/refusal and text-versus-multimodal strata.

paper_reported_experiment.setting: Multi-session vision-language conversations evaluated with text and multimodal full-memory, retrieval and agent-memory baselines.
supported_facts: Preserving multimodal information and using it effectively are separate bottlenecks.
Memory-management subtasks remain difficult and multimodal storage/retrieval adds cost.

records.strongest_boundary_or_falsifier: Visual-language only; stronger retrieval does not isolate storage, reasoning and management, and most comparisons change several memory components together.

records.title: Mem2ActBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Long-Term Memory Utilization in Task-Oriented Autonomous Agents

project_use_contract.reason: Borrow query-only, passive-retrieval and oracle-memory arms plus tool/argument and retrieved-but-unused diagnostics.

paper_reported_experiment.setting: 400 memory-dependent tool-use tasks from 2,029 long dialogue sessions; 91.3% sampled memory-dependency validity.
supported_facts: Oracle memory creates large headroom over passive retrieval.
Retrieved-but-unused errors show that retrieval and decision use must be measured separately.

records.strongest_boundary_or_falsifier: The generated text-only task is not a speech/omni reproduction target; oracle retrieval changes evidence availability rather than only memory policy.

records.title: MultiVox: A Benchmark for Evaluating Voice Assistants for Multimodal Interactions

project_use_contract.reason: Borrow paired cases with identical text/visual content and changed speech property to test non-text necessity.

paper_reported_experiment.setting: 1,000 human-recorded spoken questions paired with images/videos and evaluated on 10 omni models.
supported_facts: The paired construction directly challenges text or vision shortcuts.
Models can ground vision while neglecting paralinguistic or background-audio evidence.
source_locators: PDF pp.5-7, §3.3 and main results tables

records.strongest_boundary_or_falsifier: Single-turn benchmark evidence cannot establish persistent memory, agent control or full-duplex recovery.

records.title: VCB Bench: An Evaluation Benchmark for Audio-Grounded Large Language Model Conversational Agents

project_use_contract.reason: Borrow subjective/objective evaluator pairing and robustness perturbation strata.

paper_reported_experiment.setting: Chinese/English audio conversation tasks covering instruction following, knowledge and robustness across multiple LALMs.
supported_facts: Automatic objective scores can diverge from human subjective judgments.
Echo, unstable signal, code switching and mispronunciation expose distinct robustness failures.

records.strongest_boundary_or_falsifier: Broad coverage and heterogeneous evaluators prevent a single causal system claim; benchmark values are not comparable to other datasets.

records.title: RealTalk-CN: A Realistic Chinese Speech-Text Dialogue Benchmark With Cross-Modal Interaction Analysis

project_use_contract.reason: Borrow fluent/colloquial, speaker and cross-modal-switch strata; Chinese TOD values are not portable.

paper_reported_experiment.setting: Four Chinese speech/text task-oriented dialogue subsets with disfluency, speaker, domain and cross-modal interaction analysis.
supported_facts: Dynamic modality switching and disfluency can be tested separately from slot/intent task structure.

records.strongest_boundary_or_falsifier: Language/domain specificity and mixed task components limit direct transfer to the local English/audio task surface.

records.title: Full-Duplex-Bench-v2: A Multi-Turn Evaluation Framework for Duplex Dialogue Systems with an Automated Examiner

project_use_contract.reason: Use as nearest prior for automated multi-turn duplex evaluation; v3 is a descendant instrument, not the same revision.

paper_reported_experiment.setting: Streaming examiner/evaluatee interaction over WebRTC across Daily, Correction, Entity Tracking and Safety families.
supported_facts: The examiner supplies staged semantic goals and may interrupt to create overlap.
Turn-taking quality and semantic task completion are separate outcomes.

relations.locator: FDB-v3 official paper identity and version history; verify exact asset revision before execution

records.strongest_boundary_or_falsifier: Automated examiner speech is controlled and less natural than human interaction; evaluator-role confusion and proxy judging require independent validation.

records.title: Speech-Hands: A Self-Reflection Voice Agentic Approach to Speech Recognition and Audio Reasoning with Omni Perception

project_use_contract.reason: Reference the internal/external/rewrite action space and oracle labels; do not call the trained policy training-free.

paper_reported_experiment.setting: Qwen2.5-Omni trained with action tokens on seven ASR datasets and three audio-QA subsets.
supported_facts: Action labels are constructed using ground truth and optimized with cross-entropy.
Rewrite-token sparsity produces low recall and is a material failure mode.

records.strongest_boundary_or_falsifier: The decision policy changes core parameters and uses ground-truth-derived action labels; appendix tool experiments do not isolate tool choice from signal enhancement.

records.title: Temporal Contrastive Decoding: A Training-Free Method for Large Audio-Language Models

project_use_contract.reason: Direct audio comparator, but it needs two forward passes and next-token logits, violating the load-bearing black-box contract.

paper_reported_experiment.setting: MMAU test-mini, AIR-Bench Foundation and temporally structured audio tasks on unified LALMs.
supported_facts: Effects concentrate in sound/music and depend on access to temporally aligned audio representations.
Gains can be small or negative in speech strata on the strongest backbone.

records.strongest_boundary_or_falsifier: The method is training-free but not black-box and not reward-guided external sequential control; architectural applicability is explicitly limited.

records.title: Incentivizing Consistent, Effective and Scalable Reasoning Capability in Audio LLMs via Reasoning Process Rewards

project_use_contract.reason: Reference process-reward decomposition, scaling curves and adverse scaling; do not transfer paper values or training claims.

paper_reported_experiment.setting: Audio reasoning benchmarks including MMAU, MMSU and MMAR with process-reward components and scaling analysis.
supported_facts: Structured process rewards can change trained reasoning behavior.
Scaling behavior is not uniformly positive, motivating explicit kill criteria.

records.strongest_boundary_or_falsifier: Core weights are updated; reward keyword heuristics and benchmark-specific scoring do not establish external black-box control.

records.title: Native Active Perception as Reasoning for Omni-Modal Understanding

project_use_contract.reason: Reference observation-thought-action, persistent textual memory, browse/listen/watch actions and turn-budget curves.

paper_reported_experiment.setting: Ten long-video and omni benchmarks using direct, Agentic-SFT and TAURA-RL model stages.
supported_facts: The system explicitly separates transient percepts from persistent textual memory.
Positive test-time scaling is reported only after policy training.
source_locators: PDF experimental section and ablation tables

records.strongest_boundary_or_falsifier: Positive scaling is entangled with SFT/RL policy learning and a native model architecture, not evidence for an untrained black-box controller.

records.title: OmniRAG-Agent: Agentic Omnimodal Reasoning for Low-Resource Long Audio-Video Question Answering

project_use_contract.reason: Reference retrieve-image/retrieve-audio/stop action space, budgeted evidence banks and format-versus-answer rewards.

paper_reported_experiment.setting: Low-resource long audio-video QA with image/audio banks, up to 20 interaction turns and GRPO optimization.
supported_facts: The audio tool returns ASR text, so most retrieved audio evidence is textualized.
Training reward gates tool-call format and final-answer correctness.
source_locators: PDF main experiment and ablation tables

records.strongest_boundary_or_falsifier: The controller is parameter-trained and its audio retrieval is transcript based; it cannot establish native-audio memory or training-free control.

records.title: The Missing Piece in Pre-trained Model Evaluation: Reward-Guided Decoding Unlocks Task-Oriented Behavior Without Parameter Updates

project_use_contract.reason: Borrow direct, Best-of-N/power-sampling, reward-guided refinement, latency and reward-scale arms; model-level decoding is not the project control plane.

paper_reported_experiment.setting: Five frozen base text models on objective and subjective benchmarks with a lightweight external reward model.
supported_facts: External reward can activate task-oriented behavior without base-model updates.
The acceptance process refines outputs, not environment actions or memory/tool decisions.

records.strongest_boundary_or_falsifier: Text-only and model-output-level; the reward model is a learned component and the method does not prove sequential external-action control.

records.title: ThinkBooster: A Unified Framework for Seamless Test-Time Scaling of LLM Reasoning

project_use_contract.reason: Borrow access taxonomy, compute-quality accounting and modular generator/scorer/strategy interfaces.

paper_reported_experiment.setting: Math, code and CUDA generation tasks evaluated with multiple TTS strategies and scorers.
supported_facts: The framework explicitly labels black-box and white-box strategies.
Only a subset remains usable with fully hosted black-box models.

records.strongest_boundary_or_falsifier: Text-only; several strategies require logits, hidden states or prefill, and step-boundary extraction is deployment dependent.

records.title: Limits and Gains of Test-Time Scaling in Vision-Language Reasoning

project_use_contract.reason: Borrow zero-shot, CoT, Best-of-N, self-consistency, self-refinement and beam arms plus external/internal verifier separation.

paper_reported_experiment.setting: Open and closed VLMs on MathVista, MMMU and MMBench; N=5 for multi-sample arms.
supported_facts: External verification is more reliable than internal confidence in the reported open-model settings.
Self-refinement can degrade open models and perception-focused tasks show little headroom.

records.strongest_boundary_or_falsifier: Methods, models and verifier access vary across cells; the paper is a directional falsifier, not a pooled universal effect estimate.

records.title: Visual Test-time Scaling for GUI Agent Grounding

project_use_contract.reason: Borrow trigger/no-trigger, focused observation, candidate actions, visual history, aggregation, budget and repair-success arms.

paper_reported_experiment.setting: ScreenSpot-Pro and WebVoyager with multiple GUI-agent backbones and error-triggered RegionFocus.
comparisons: fixed box versus predicted region versus SAM
supported_facts: Environmental feedback can trigger additional perception and action selection without model retraining.
Visual history outperforms text coordinate history in the reported ablation.

records.strongest_boundary_or_falsifier: The static setting uses a VLM judge as trigger and reports substantial inference overhead; reward is not independently calibrated.

records.title: VISUALSKILL: Multimodal Skills for Computer-Use Agents

project_use_contract.reason: Borrow no-skill, matched text-only and multimodal skill arms, on-demand loading, consult/use diagnostics and construction-stage ablations.

paper_reported_experiment.setting: 177 tasks from CUA-World and OSExpert-Eval with Claude Code CLI/Claude Opus 4.6 and application-specific skills.
supported_facts: The text-only control is generated from the same source and differs primarily in modality.
Visual figures improve UI element identification and intermediate-state verification in the reported cells.

records.strongest_boundary_or_falsifier: Single agent/backbone and GUI tasks; construction stages can change content as well as modality, so only the explicitly matched control supports MM3 attribution.

records.title: SkillOps: Managing LLM Agent Skill Libraries as Self-Maintaining Software Ecosystems

project_use_contract.reason: Borrow skill contracts, validators, repair/merge/retire actions, health metrics and raw-versus-maintained library comparisons.

paper_reported_experiment.setting: ALFWorld with curated and synthetically degraded skill libraries from 200 to 2,000 entries.
supported_facts: Maintenance helps retrieval-heavy baselines more than already filtering planners.
Synthetic degradation is used beyond the 229 curated skills.

records.strongest_boundary_or_falsifier: Text-only ALFWorld and synthetic library debt; maintenance benefits are method conditional and cannot establish multimodal skill value.

records.title: When Seeing Is not Enough: Revealing the Limits of Active Reasoning in MLLMs

project_use_contract.reason: Borrow full-information ceiling, partial-information active acquisition, question utility and stop-timing diagnostics.

paper_reported_experiment.setting: GuessBench candidate-image pools with perception- and knowledge-oriented categories across 20 MLLMs.
supported_facts: High passive accuracy does not imply effective active evidence acquisition.
Fine-grained perception and premature/late decisions are separable failure modes.

records.strongest_boundary_or_falsifier: Synthetic images/captions and an external answer source create a game-like protocol; question asking is not equivalent to audio-tool use or reward-guided control.

records.title: M3-VQA: A Benchmark for Multimodal, Multi-Entity, Multi-Hop Visual Question Answering

project_use_contract.reason: Borrow no-evidence, gold-evidence, heuristic-retrieval and agentic-retrieval arms with evidence-chain traceability.

paper_reported_experiment.setting: About 13k multi-entity, sequential/parallel multi-hop VQA items with a curated multimodal knowledge base and 16 MLLMs.
supported_facts: Gold evidence provides an upper-bound diagnostic distinct from retrieval quality.
Agentic retrieval is evaluated against heuristic retrieval, not only no-RAG.
source_locators: PDF experiment section and main results tables

records.strongest_boundary_or_falsifier: Vision-language entity QA is not a speech task; retrieval and reasoning interventions may change together in the agentic arm.

records.title: From Scenes to Elements: Multi-Granularity Evidence Retrieval for Verifiable Multimodal RAG

project_use_contract.reason: Borrow element/scene evidence granularity, partial-observation controls and attribution precision/recall/unsupported-claim outcomes.

paper_reported_experiment.setting: 1,422 images across 71 landmarks with element visibility labels; multiple LLMs under baseline, CoT and GranuRAG settings.
comparisons: text-only gold versus image plus all/chosen elements
supported_facts: Detection, retrieval and generation failures can be measured separately.
Even the best configuration leaves substantial unsupported-claim rate.

records.strongest_boundary_or_falsifier: Landmark-only Chinese benchmark and pipeline/fine-tuning variants; attribution remains incomplete and no audio modality is tested.

records.title: Utility-Oriented Visual Evidence Selection for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation

project_use_contract.reason: Borrow relevance-versus-utility, zero-RAG, top-k, gold-oracle, answer-uncertainty and surrogate/main-model arms.

paper_reported_experiment.setting: MRAG-Bench and Visual-RAG across five MLLM families with candidate visual evidence and top-k selection.
supported_facts: Semantic relevance and answer confidence can rank unhelpful evidence highly.
The utility probe is training-free but reads final-layer logits.

records.strongest_boundary_or_falsifier: The selector requires gray-box logits from a separate surrogate and uses a learned model; it is not a strict black-box control-plane implementation.

records.title: ImplicitMemBench: Measuring Unconscious Behavioral Adaptation in Large Language Models

project_use_contract.reason: Borrow learn/prime-interfere-test timing, first-attempt scoring and procedural-memory versus skill distinction.

paper_reported_experiment.setting: 300 items across procedural memory, priming and classical conditioning; 17 models and human comparison.
supported_facts: Explicit recall and automatic enactment are different outcomes.
First-attempt scoring prevents later self-correction from masking missing automaticity.

records.strongest_boundary_or_falsifier: Text-only, within-context exposure may be in-context learning rather than durable memory; automatic judges are used for some constructs.

records.title: Agentic Memory: Learning Unified Long-Term and Short-Term Memory Management for Large Language Model Agents

project_use_contract.reason: Reference explicit add/update/delete/retrieve/summarize/discard action space and unified LTM/STM coordination.

paper_reported_experiment.setting: Five long-horizon text benchmarks across multiple LLM backbones with progressive RL stages.
supported_facts: The work operationalizes memory management as tool actions.
All reported policy gains follow parameter training with step-wise GRPO.
source_locators: PDF pp.1-4, Figure 1 and method section

records.strongest_boundary_or_falsifier: Text-only and parameter-trained; unified policy gains cannot be attributed to training-free external memory control.
